card.summary: The Risky Research Review Act creates an independent agency in the executive branch called the Life Sciences Research Security Board. The Board is responsible for reviewing and making binding determinations on whether federal agencies may award funding for high-risk life sciences research, such as dual-use research of concern involving high-consequence pathogens or gain-of-function research.
